mission: Deliver one validated NexusCentral application from one source tree, with desktop and web runtime profiles, local-owned user state, routing-only shared model capacity, internal application APIs, and evidence-gated harness execution.
objective: Identify generated and transient paths without deleting them.

acceptedEvidence.claim: Durable candidates are isolated; deferred generated, transient, and unresolved paths are ready for non-mutating classification.

allowedReads: Fresh pending path names and statuses
Ignore rules and bounded metadata for deferred files
exclusions: No deletion, reset, clean, move, rename, checkout, or source-content edit
No secret values copied into classification evidence
acceptanceGate: Transient classification contains no deletion or reset action.
oneFixPlan: Classify generated, transient, unresolved, and late control artifacts with owners and no-action retention.
validationCommand: Require complete fresh status coverage and verify every non-durable path has owner, class, reason, and noAction true.
cancellationRule: Stop before deletion or when a path cannot be safely classified as unresolved.
